title: Tolerability of SLIT With LAIS® 2-Tree Allergoid Tablets
brief_summary: To expand knowledge on the application and tolerability of immunotherapy with LAIS® 2-tree allergoid tablets as well as knowledge on the alleviation of symptoms during sublingual therapy in special consideration of the chosen titration schedule in everyday practice.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients aged 5 years or older having allergies within the scope of specifications stated in the patient information leaflet

Exclusion Criteria:

* Contraindications according to the patient information leaflet
study_population: Patients aged 5 years or older can be enrolled in the NIS if sublingual specific immunotherapy has been indicated due to allergic rhinoconjunctivitis or allergic bronchial asthma induced by the allergens to be investigated (birch and/or alder).
